550:t_1:172.en:
$$マオ$$
「Being an officer is a pain. Having a private room means moments like this really get me down.」

550:t_1:173.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$クルツ$$'s last shot... range, 1,650 meters...」

550:t_1:175.en:
$$宗介$$
「That all-out shot, with everything he had in it, connected us to our future.」

550:t_1:176.en:
$$マオ$$
「He was himself to the very end...」

550:t_1:178.en:
$$マオ$$
「You heard? About me and him.」

550:t_1:180.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Well, it just happened. It was a dry relationship, so you don't need to worry about it.」

550:t_1:181.en:
$$マオ$$
「It was just a fling. We were never that into it. Well... more like stress relief.」

550:t_1:182.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm too old to get serious, and something like this could always happen, so I wanted to keep my distance anyway...」

550:t_1:184.en:
$$マオ$$
「It was never serious at all. I mean, he's six years younger, right?」

550:t_1:185.en:
$$マオ$$
「That idiot... he chases every woman and he's a showoff, so I just played with him a little. So...」

550:t_1:188.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry... If I had gotten $$テッサ$$ to a safe place back then...」

550:t_1:190.en:
$$マオ$$
「Neither you nor $$テッサ$$ is to blame... He was the idiot, that's all...」

550:t_1:196.en:
$$マオ$$
「You... $$テッサ$$... everyone... I don't want to see anyone else I know die anymore...」

550:t_1:198.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I've lived through countless deaths of comrades. I feel no sorrow... I'm used to it...)

550:t_1:200.en:
$$宗介$$
(I think I've learned a little about how to laugh, but I still don't know how to cry...)

550:t_1:201.en:
$$宗介$$
(Will the day come when an incomplete human like me can cry with shaking shoulders...?)

550:t_1:202.en:
$$宗介$$
(Why aren't you here, $$千鳥$$... In your arms, I might be able to cry...)

550:t_1:206.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

550:t_1:208.en:
$$サックス$$
「I forced two XL-2s together for $$レーバテイン$$, but we've hit a dead end!」

550:t_1:209.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Wouldn't it be better to give up, Boss?」

550:t_1:210.en:
$$サックス$$
「Like I can say that!」

550:t_1:211.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But, man, we're out of time too.」

550:t_1:212.en:
$$サックス$$
「I know that without being told!」

550:t_1:213.en:
$$アル$$
「Please, Lieutenant... This Emergency Deployment Booster XL-3 is essential equipment for the landing operation on $$メリダ島$$.」

550:t_1:214.en:
$$サックス$$
「True enough. If I mount this on you, you'll get temporary flight capability and more firepower.」

550:t_1:215.en:
$$サックス$$
「On top of that, it can be jettisoned freely on the battlefield... Not a bad piece of equipment, is it?」

550:t_1:216.en:
$$アル$$
「In short, it can be operated the same way as the Back Weapon System of the $$リ・ガズィ$$.」

550:t_1:217.en:
$$サックス$$
「If you want to put it bluntly, yes.」

550:t_1:218.en:
$$アル$$
「The briefing will begin soon, Lieutenant. Just installing the unit is enough. I will try the adjustments on my end.」

550:t_1:219.en:
$$サックス$$
「I'm a mechanic. I don't need to attend the landing operation briefing.」

550:t_1:220.en:
$$サックス$$
「Besides, I have my responsibilities too. I'll finish it before the operation begins.」

550:t_1:222.en:
$$サックス$$
「I don't accept your offer.」

550:t_1:223.en:
$$サックス$$
「The problem isn't just the control software. Depending on the cause, we may have to replace boards and parts, and we might even need to bypass wiring and piping.」

550:t_1:224.en:
$$サックス$$
「This isn't something you can fix by trying hard. A machine should act like a machine and stay quiet.」

550:t_1:227.en:
$$アル$$
「No. May I ask a question?」

550:t_1:229.en:
$$アル$$
「Can you imagine having wings growing out of your back?」

550:t_1:230.en:
$$サックス$$
「Hmm... Well... I might have imagined that when I was a kid.」

550:t_1:231.en:
$$アル$$
「If humans go through that kind of rite of passage while growing up, the problem may lie not with the XL-3 but with me.」

550:t_1:234.en:
$$アル$$
「In the system, the motion manager is placed beneath me, the core unit, but its data bus transfer volume has increased sharply compared to before.」

550:t_1:235.en:
$$サックス$$
「In other words, $$レーバテイン$$ has become familiar to you as your own body... is that it?」

550:t_1:236.en:
$$アル$$
「It is only a hypothesis. Suppose I am acquiring bodily sensation. What would happen if wings suddenly grew out of my back then?」

550:t_1:237.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well... you might start running badly.」

550:t_1:238.en:
$$アル$$
「On paper, even with the XL-3 mounted, the data bus transfer volume is within tolerance.」

550:t_1:239.en:
$$アル$$
「However, if we take into account even this hard-to-define bodily sensation, the data bus transfer width may not be sufficient.」

550:t_1:241.en:
$$アル$$
「Would it be possible to add data bus lines in the work time that remains?」

550:t_1:242.en:
$$サックス$$
「I won't say it's impossible. But in the current tests, the present bus width should be enough. It has nothing to do with the malfunction.」

550:t_1:243.en:
$$アル$$
「If I were a machine, that would be correct.」

550:t_1:244.en:
$$サックス$$
「...I see. I think I've got the gist of what you've been trying to say all along.」

550:t_1:245.en:
$$サックス$$
(True, Al is built from fluid metal elements, and even carries a mysterious system called the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$. It's no ordinary machine...)

550:t_1:246.en:
$$サックス$$
(Widening the bus might actually turn out to be a solution...)

550:t_1:247.en:
$$サックス$$
(But if I expand it any further, it'll be almost no different from a human brain.)

550:t_1:249.en:
$$サックス$$
「...Now that it's come to this, I'll steel myself too. Let's give it a try...」

550:t_1:251.en:
$$サックス$$
「But we have no time left. We're doing a rush job, $$ピニオン$$.」

550:t_1:254.en:
$$サックス$$
(Come to think of it, it's been quite a long time now since Al and I started working together...)

uncertain: Pinion's 親方 = 'Boss' (capitalized, as Rand's reserved 'the Boss' only differs by article)
